newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Banco Mercantil says level 1 ADRs approved by SEC.
newsitem.headline: Banco Mercantil says level 1 ADRs approved by SEC.

text.p: Venezuela's Banco Mercantil, the country's second largest commercial bank, said on Monday the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission had approved its planned level one American Depository Receipt (ADR) issue.
A bank official, who asked not to be named, said the issue would be equivalent to 10 ordinary shares and would take place shortly.
The Morgan Guaranty Trust Co of New York will act as depository for the ADR program, which will not be used to raise capital, the bank said in a a release.
Banco Mercantil will act as custodian of the ADRs, the release added.
The SEC approval came on August 14, one month after the application was made, the bank said.
At the end of July, Banco Mercantil was the second biggest in terms of deposits 428 billion ($900 million).
